title: I sold Christopher Lloyd's house, and lost my mind a little
story: A few months ago I helped sell 742 North Sycamore, the Hollywood home Christopher Lloyd lovingly transformed and made his own. He left an actual mold of his face somewhere in that house. I grew up watching Back to the Future more times than I can count, so representing this one felt personal in a way most listings don't. It closed at $2.82M, and my seller Diva was an absolute dream through every twist, sewer line drama included.
pullQuote: Some houses are just square footage. This one had a piece of my childhood built into the walls.

title: A buyer's win in Glendale
story: I represented the buyer on 2621 East Glenoaks Boulevard in Glendale, which closed at an even $2,000,000. Even after we closed, I stayed on top of the details that mattered, chasing down a fire hazard disclosure issue with escrow so my buyer never had to think twice about it. That's the job as far as I'm concerned: the work doesn't stop the moment the keys change hands.
